parent_transaction_contract.namespace: modal_admission.vNext; parent-owned control plane, not a workflow/bank permission. No existing source changed.
parent_transaction_contract.authoritative_writer: One parent coordinator on one host owns the authoritative ledger and all cloud launch/cancel calls. Serialize with an OS-enforced exclusive lock or SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE; JSON snapshots alone and atomic rename alone are not compare-and-swap. OneDrive-synchronized files must not be the cross-host lock authority. A durable unsynchronized local journal may be authoritative with modal-budget.json as its parent-written projection; parent selects/owns location. No second host/writer permitted.
parent_transaction_contract.identity: Grant nonce is parent-generated unique random>=128bits, never reused, stored with experiment_id,reservation_id,invocation_id,ordinal,payload/schema/source/image/dependency/adjudication hashes, selected verified workspace/environment, resource ceilings, fixed deadlines and expiry. It is local single-use capability evidence, not cryptographic proof of external identity.
parent_transaction_contract.ledger_revision: Monotone integer ledger_revision and append-only transition sequence; reject revision rollback, duplicate nonce, malformed/nonfinite amounts, duplicate IDs, unresolved previous launch. Existing JSON files are untrusted inputs until verified against authoritative journal.
parent_transaction_contract.immutable_binding: Hash the immutable grant/resources/data manifests, not the entire mutable global ledger. Child receives an immutable launch receipt containing consumed nonce, invocation ID, owner/fencing token and absolute deadlines. It checks the current invocation state through the coordinator. Legitimate starting transition must not invalidate its own receipt.
parent_consume_transaction: Acquire exclusive transaction; reload authoritative ledger and recompute accounting and all evidence gates.
Require nonce status admitted_unlaunched, unexpired, exact manifest/workspace/resource hashes, all required evidence present, no active/unknown invocation and no unclaimed competing starter.

Compute ordinal = 1 + count(all invocations ever transitioned to starting for this work, across experiment IDs). Require ordinal<=3. A cancelled/failed/timed-out starting attempt still counts permanently; no refunded retry slots and no reset by creating a new experiment ID.

Allocate a unique per-invocation subreservation from the <=USD10 experiment envelope; require global projected exposure<=USD30 launch target and<=USD35 hard cap. Do not create three independentUSD10 grants for oneUSD10 experiment.

Atomically change admitted_unlaunched->starting, mark nonce consumed, increment attemptcount, assign owner/fencing token, persist fixed startup/cancel/hardstop deadlines and register armed independent watchdog. Commit/fsync before any subprocess that could create cloud resources.

Only after successful commit may parent create one isolated child. If processcreation fails, record launch_failed_no_remote only with evidence no remote operation began; count remains consumed. Never move back to admitted_unlaunched.
parent_transaction_contract.child_claim_transaction: Child must request one atomic claim starting->launch_claimed through the coordinator using exact receipt/fence; then appcreation may begin. Read-only checks of starting are insufficient because two children can pass. Replaying receipt after claim, appcreation or any later state denies. If coordinator cannot be reached, fail before SDK/import that performs network work.
parent_transaction_contract.external_effect_boundary: Local CAS proves at-most-one launch claim, not exactly-once remote creation under network failure. Before each external app creation or spawn, journal an intent; after response journal returned exact ID durably. Crash/timeout after request but before ID acknowledgment enters remote_unknown. Never automatically retry such an intent unless verified provider idempotency semantics exist and were deliberately implemented. Local nonce cannot provide remote exactly-once semantics by itself.

Bounded stop procedure using only independently bound exact IDs; recording an attempt is not success.
Authoritative, uniquely matching stopped/zero-resource evidence for all related resources; budget hold remains.
Parent reconciles actual billed cost with evidence and releases unused reservation atomically.
Positive local evidence no app/create network intent was issued; nonce/attempt remain consumed.
Parent withdraws/expiry before consume; nonce cannot be revived.
